description: Shaheen Insurance Company Limited is a Pakistani general insurer incorporated as a public limited company in 1996 as a project of the Shaheen Foundation, the welfare organisation set up by the Pakistan Air Force, which remains its major shareholder. It writes general insurance for corporate, multinational and individual clients and is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It began with paid-up capital of Rs 20 million, which its site now gives as Rs 600 million.
sourceNote: Company website (shaheeninsurance.com/corporate-profile: incorporation in 1996, the Shaheen Foundation and PAF ownership, general insurance business, listing and paid-up capital growth; the site header for the Karachi telephone numbers and Shaheen Complex location), and the chief executive from the company's own quarterly report for the period ended 31 March 2026 published on its site, which lists Rizwan Akhtar as chief executive officer, read 2026-10-17. No fuller postal address is published on the pages read.
